systems.title: What I Built
systems.metasounds.title: MetaSounds Engine
systems.metasounds.desc: Procedural go-kart audio driven by a MetaSounds graph. Pitch and rattle shift with speed in real-time. No pre-baked loops.
systems.mix.title: Mix Strategy
systems.mix.desc: Priority system with ducking for 4-player headroom. Item pickups duck collisions, countdown and Wall of Death cut through everything.
systems.surface.title: Surface Transitions
systems.surface.desc: Crossfade between surface materials so driving from carpet onto tiles sounds smooth instead of glitchy.
challenges.title: Challenges & Solutions
challenges.c1_problem: With 4 players going at once, sounds stacked up and UI feedback disappeared.
challenges.c1_solution: Capped collision sounds at 4, gave each player a different EQ range, and ducked the crowd whenever UI plays.
challenges.c2_problem: Switching between asphalt, sand, and metal caused audio pops.
challenges.c2_solution: Added 150ms crossfades between surfaces. Problem gone.
challenges.c3_problem: Boost sounds were eating 160MB with 4 players active.
challenges.c3_solution: Replaced them with procedural MetaSounds patches. From 160MB down to under 2MB per player.
